annotations.text:
PoliVerse in the Kyo 2.0 language. Home: patterned background, contextual greeting, big wide date with an accent accessory ('Tutto pronto?'), task cards inside a soft translucent ring, the timetable as overlapping full-colour cards ('Terminata', 'Mancano', → next time, room chip, a white break pill), courses as colour tiles, then news. At the bottom the glossy day pill and accent button float over an 'Azioni e ricerca globale' search sheet, instead of a tab bar.
Sheets use Kyo's anatomy: a centred glyph, title and description, capsule fields split icon | text | value, a glossy N/D report card, a glossy exam card, and floating glossy buttons.
'Tema' is a theme manager (material, colour, widget, accessory).
Use the Theme and Pattern chips above each frame to switch Arancio / Viola / Blu / Rosa and Griglia / Maglia ovale / Puntini. All content is sample data.

Flow taken from the Kyo recording, rebuilt for PoliVerse in dark mode: (1) the round accent button opens a menu with settings, a Corsi/Docenti split row and quick adds; (2) Personalizza rises as a sheet with a bento of Materiale (page curl), Stile, Widget, Accessorio, Icona, Motivo and colour; (3) tapping a tile opens its picker, a carousel of options with 'Selezionato' and a font button. The empty states are pills with a single plain sentence.
